name: models_with_line_counts
note: verifier: reconcile model form lists its lines (embedded line array) and partners per model with rule type, trigger and can-be-proposed flag
source_sql: SELECT m.id, m.rule_type, m.trigger, m.can_be_proposed, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_reconcile_model_line l WHERE l.model_id = m.id) AS lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_reconcile_model_res_partner_rel p WHERE p.account_reconcile_model_id = m.id) AS partners FROM account_reconcile_model m ORDER BY m.id
